scope: Verified Slay the Spire 1 / Ironclad / Ascension 0 threat facts used by VEDA's readiness assessment. These claims do not select a path or force an action.

claims.statement: Shockwave costs 2 Energy, applies 3 Weak and 3 Vulnerable to all enemies, and Exhausts; its upgrade applies 5 of each debuff.
Ghostly Armor costs 1 Energy, gains 10 Block, and is Ethereal; an Ethereal card remaining in hand at end of turn Exhausts.
Weak reduces Attack damage by 25%; Vulnerable makes Attack damage received 50% greater; Frail reduces Block gained from cards by 25%. Rounding can matter for small or multi-hit attacks.
Gremlin Nob gains Strength whenever the player plays a Skill. At Ascension 0 it begins with Bellow for 2 Enrage, then can use Skull Bash for 6 damage plus 2 Vulnerable or Bull Rush for 14 damage.
Lagavulin begins asleep with 8 Metallicize; damaging it gives one stunned turn, after which it repeats Attack for 18, Attack for 18, then Siphon Soul for -1 Strength and -1 Dexterity at Ascension 0.
In the Act 1 Sentries Elite, each Sentry has Artifact 1. The outer Sentries alternate Bolt, which adds 2 Dazed, and Beam for 9 damage; the middle Sentry starts with Beam instead.

The Act 1 boss is one of Slime Boss, The Guardian, or Hexaghost, and its portrait is shown at the top of the map. VEDA must observe the actual boss before converting boss-specific advice into a route or card decision.
claims.conditions: The possible boss set and portrait fact are sourced; the observation requirement is VEDA's safety policy.
